clearance. Do not give up the task.

source_review.review: 272 source frames at 5 s intervals across the full run; first arm approach and final withdrawal at 0.5 s intervals; initial/final external frames and selected inline observations.
source_review.endpoint: Tube upright and independently supported after open-gripper withdrawal. Final stereo evidence returned at source 1346.367 s; end at source 1348 s with 2.5 s hold.
source_review.framing: Original 16:9 full frame, letterboxed into the recording column. All camera movement is from original footage.
source_review.model_evidence: GPT-6-Astra from entry 1, high effort from entry 3 before the task; all assistant metadata checked.
